study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial with cancer hospitalization as a secondary endpoint
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 3069 GEM participants 75+ years of age were randomized to twice-daily doses of either 120 mg Ginkgo extract (EGb 761) or placebo and followed for a median 6.1 years.
reason: The trial evaluates prostate cancer hospitalization during follow-up but does not distinguish aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Among the site-specific cancers analyzed, we observed an increased risk of breast (HR, 2.15; 95%CI, 0.97-4.80; p = 0.06) and colorectal (HR, 1.62; 95%CI, 0.92-2.87; p = 0.10) cancer, and a reduced risk of prostate cancer (HR, 0.71; 95%CI, 0.43-1.17; p = 0.18).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is for prostate cancer generally, with no aggressive-disease restriction.
